# Imported Runnable option contracts

The following files are copied byte for byte from codefly-dev/core commit `50c2b2ab29a47504cb81195670361d140745f6cb`.
They are import-only; Core registers their Go descriptors. Generate only the
owned `saas` tree with `--path saas`. The existing `codefly/api.proto` client
facade stays excluded.

- `codefly/base/v1/agent.proto`
- `codefly/base/v1/endpoint.proto`
- `codefly/base/v1/library.proto`
- `codefly/base/v1/network.proto`
- `codefly/base/v1/readiness.proto`
- `codefly/base/v1/runnable.proto`
- `codefly/base/v1/scope.proto`
- `codefly/base/v1/work_context.proto`
- `codefly/runnable/v1/options.proto`
